{{velocity}} #set ($rpClass = 'SensitivityBanner.Code.SensitivityClass') #set ($rpLimit = 50000) ## Pages with at least one value (a partial XWQL query returns document names). #set ($rpWithValue = $services.query.xwql("from doc.object($rpClass) as obj where obj.owner <> '' or obj.security <> '' or obj.country <> ''").setLimit($rpLimit).execute()) #set ($rpHave = {}) #foreach ($rpName in $rpWithValue) #set ($discard = $rpHave.put($rpName, true)) #end ## Candidate pages, narrowed the same way the banner is. #if ($sbExcludeTerminal) #set ($rpStmt = "where doc.translation = 0 and doc.name = 'WebHome' order by doc.fullName") #else #set ($rpStmt = "where doc.translation = 0 order by doc.fullName") #end #set ($rpCandidates = $services.query.xwql($rpStmt).setLimit($rpLimit).execute()) ## Application Within Minutes application pages, when the banner skips them. #set ($rpApps = {}) #if ($sbExcludeApps && $xwiki.exists('AppWithinMinutes.LiveTableClass')) #foreach ($rpName in $services.query.xwql("from doc.object(AppWithinMinutes.LiveTableClass) as obj").setLimit($rpLimit).execute()) #set ($discard = $rpApps.put($rpName, true)) #end #end #set ($rpMissing = []) #foreach ($rpName in $rpCandidates) #if (!$rpHave.containsKey($rpName) && !$rpApps.containsKey($rpName)) #set ($rpParts = $rpName.split('\.')) #set ($rpTop = $rpParts[0]) #if (!$sbExcludedList.contains($rpTop)) #set ($discard = $rpMissing.add($rpName)) #end #end #end ## Values that are no longer in the configured lists. #set ($rpRetired = []) #foreach ($rpName in $rpWithValue) #if ($foreach.count <= 1000) #set ($rpObj = $xwiki.getDocument($rpName).getObject($rpClass)) #if ($rpObj) #foreach ($rpField in $sbFields) #set ($rpVal = "$!rpObj.getValue($rpField)") #set ($rpVal = $rpVal.trim()) #if ($rpVal != '') #set ($rpOk = false) #foreach ($rpOpt in $sbOptions.get($rpField)) #if ($rpOpt.label == $rpVal) #set ($rpOk = true) #end #end #if (!$rpOk) #set ($discard = $rpRetired.add({'page': $rpName, 'field': $sbLabels.get($rpField), 'value': $rpVal})) #end #end #end #end #end #end == Summary ==
* Pages with at least one value: **$rpHave.size()#if ($rpWithValue.size() >= $rpLimit) or more#end** * Pages missing sensitivity: **$rpMissing.size()#if ($rpCandidates.size() >= $rpLimit) or more#end** * Values no longer in the configured lists: **$rpRetired.size()**
The missing list follows the same rules as the banner: excluded spaces, terminal pages and Application Within Minutes pages are left out if those settings are on. #if ($rpCandidates.size() >= $rpLimit || $rpWithValue.size() >= $rpLimit)**This wiki has $rpLimit or more matching pages, so the counts and lists below are cut off. The table below is not capped, and its footer should show the exact number of entries.**#end
